_doc: Composed active skills of the 28 Kings and 28 Monsters: each has its own list of effect ops (BattleEngine.SKILL_OPS / _run_skill_fx). Generated by tools/gen_kit.py.

dawnbreak_decree.name: Dawnbreak Decree
dawnbreak_decree.desc: Manual, once: deals 120% ATK to all enemies and heals every ally for 10% of its max HP.

umbral_pact.name: Umbral Pact
umbral_pact.desc: Manual, once: teleports to the weakest enemy and hits it for 220% ATK and takes 50% less damage for 10 ticks.

ironbound_rampart.name: Ironbound Rampart
ironbound_rampart.desc: Manual, once: every ally gains a shield worth 20% of its max HP and gains a shield worth 30% of max HP.

stardust_snare.name: Stardust Snare
stardust_snare.desc: Manual, once: hits 3 random enemies for 200% ATK and slows all enemies for 8 ticks.

starfall_execution.name: Starfall Execution
starfall_execution.desc: Manual, once: enemies below 40% HP take 320% ATK.

emberlord_pyre.name: Emberlord's Pyre
emberlord_pyre.desc: Manual, once: burns all enemies for 35% ATK every 4 ticks for 12 ticks and enemies within 3 cells take 120% ATK.

absolute_zero.name: Absolute Zero
absolute_zero.desc: Manual, once: slows all enemies for 12 ticks and enemies take 15% more damage for 12 ticks.

hollow_communion.name: Hollow Communion
hollow_communion.desc: Manual, once: hits the toughest enemy for 200% ATK and heals 100% of the damage and gains a shield worth 15% of max HP.

goliath_protocol.name: Goliath Protocol
goliath_protocol.desc: Manual, once: gains a shield worth 45% of max HP and gains +30% ATK for 12 ticks.

overload_pulse.name: Overload Pulse
overload_pulse.desc: Manual, once: enemies in its row take 180% ATK and stuns the 2 highest-ATK enemies for 2 ticks.

stasis_field.name: Stasis Field
stasis_field.desc: Manual, once: stuns enemies within 3 cells for 4 ticks and allies attack faster for 10 ticks.

arbiters_verdict.name: Arbiter's Verdict
arbiters_verdict.desc: Manual, once: hits the 2 highest-ATK enemies for 240% ATK and every ally gains a shield worth 10% of its max HP.

verdant_renewal.name: Thornwarden's Renewal
verdant_renewal.desc: Manual, once: heals every ally for 20% of its max HP and cleanses allies of stun, slow and burn.

alphas_hunt.name: Alpha's Hunt
alphas_hunt.desc: Manual, once: gains +50% ATK for 12 ticks and teleports to the weakest enemy and hits it for 180% ATK.

bloom_sanctuary.name: Bloom Sanctuary
bloom_sanctuary.desc: Manual, once: heals the most wounded ally for 60% of its max HP and every ally takes 50% less damage for 8 ticks.

mountains_wrath.name: Mountain's Wrath
mountains_wrath.desc: Manual, once: enemies within 2 cells take 160% ATK and gains a shield worth 35% of max HP.

dragonbreath.name: Dragonbreath
dragonbreath.desc: Manual, once: enemies in its column take 260% ATK and burns all enemies for 25% ATK every 4 ticks for 8 ticks.

hellbride_wedding.name: Hellbride's Wedding
hellbride_wedding.desc: Manual, once: deals 130% ATK to all enemies and burns all enemies for 20% ATK every 4 ticks for 8 ticks.

blood_harvest.name: Blood Harvest
blood_harvest.desc: Manual, once: hits the toughest enemy for 260% ATK and heals 100% of the damage and gains +25% ATK for 12 ticks.

warcry_of_krogg.name: Warcry of Krogg
warcry_of_krogg.desc: Manual, once: every ally gains +30% ATK for 12 ticks and gains a shield worth 20% of max HP.

crushing_depths.name: Crushing Depths
crushing_depths.desc: Manual, once: slows all enemies for 10 ticks and deals 90% ATK to all enemies.

tidemother_tide.name: Tidemother's Tide
tidemother_tide.desc: Manual, once: heals every ally for 15% of its max HP and every ally gains a shield worth 10% of its max HP.

storm_barrage.name: Storm Surge Barrage
storm_barrage.desc: Manual, once: hits 4 random enemies for 180% ATK and stuns the highest-ATK enemy for 2 ticks.

broadside_boarding.name: Broadside Boarding
broadside_boarding.desc: Manual, once: teleports to the weakest enemy and hits it for 280% ATK and enemies within 1 cells take 120% ATK.

eclipse_corona.name: Eclipse Corona
eclipse_corona.desc: Manual, once: deals 110% ATK to all enemies and every ally gains +20% ATK for 10 ticks.

paradox_cascade.name: Paradox Cascade
paradox_cascade.desc: Manual, once: teleports to the weakest enemy and hits it for 250% ATK and grants 2 energy.

unending_cycle.name: Unending Cycle
unending_cycle.desc: Manual, once: heals 35% of its max HP, revives the last fallen ally at 40% HP, and cleanses allies of stun, slow and burn.

oblivion_edict.name: Oblivion's Edict
oblivion_edict.desc: Manual, once: enemies below 50% HP take 260% ATK and drains 3 energy from the enemy side.

crownstone_bulwark.name: Crownstone Bulwark
crownstone_bulwark.desc: Manual, once: gains a shield worth 40% of max HP, takes 50% less damage for 10 ticks, and stuns enemies within 1 cells for 2 ticks.

sunfire_eruption.name: Sunfire Eruption

shadehound_pounce.name: Shadehound Pounce

arc_hound_storm.name: Arc Hound Storm

rootmaw_devour.name: Rootmaw Devour
